# Inkdraft

> Inkdraft is an AI tattoo design tool for tattoo artists. It turns a client's brief into four drawn concepts, variations of the chosen one and a clean single-weight stencil ready for Procreate, plus an on-skin preview to show the client, in blackwork, traditional or fine line. It is built for artists who are starting out or still finding their style: a help to learn to think a design through, not a house style. The artist always chooses, reworks and finishes the tattoo.

- Website: https://www.inkdraft.tattoo/ (English) · https://www.inkdraft.tattoo/es/ (Spanish)
- Contact: hello@inkdraft.tattoo
- Status: pre-sale. 50 founder seats at €19/month for life. Founders get beta access in early December 2026.

## How it works
1. Brief: describe the client's request (subject, placement, size), optionally with up to 3 reference photos, read as taste and never copied.
2. Concepts: four different concepts, each with its own drawing. The artist picks by eye.
3. Variations: three variations of the chosen concept (close, medium, bold).
4. Stencil: single-weight linework, true to the drawing, at 2048 px, no shading. Opens in Procreate.
5. On skin: upload a photo of the placement, position the design and get a realistic preview for the client.

## Styles
- Blackwork: antique engraving linework, creatures fused with objects, solid black anchor.
- Traditional: classic color flash, bold clean outline, smooth black shading, short palette of red, yellow and green. The stencil also traces the border of every color.
- Fine line: single-needle line, botanical truth, plenty of bare skin. Lettering is not drawn yet: the design leaves room for it and the artist sets real type in Procreate.
- The same brief can be drawn in all three styles. Founders can ask for other styles.

## Pricing (EUR, monthly)
- Trial: €0, 3 designs, no card.
- Starter: €19, 10 designs.
- Pro: €39, 30 designs.
- Studio: €99, 100 designs, up to 5 artists.
- Founder seat (pre-sale, 50 seats): Pro plan at €19/month for life.
A design = idea + drawn concept + stencil + on-skin preview.

## Who it's for
Tattoo artists starting out who want to learn to build concepts faster, artists with some years in who want to try other styles, and studios training apprentices. Not meant for top artists who already have their own style and process.

## Ownership
Artists own what they generate: free to tattoo, post and sell.
